question: Do authenticated EMC models or specimens show a directly measured lipid-redox/ferroptosis vulnerability with an informative control or rescue comparison?
hypothesized_finding: A matched-exposure EMC-versus-control sensitivity contrast to GPX4 or cystine-import inhibition, supported by lipid-peroxidation measurement and mechanism-specific rescue, could establish a useful new EMC experiment. This is a hypothesis, not an existing result.
rationale: Mesenchymal morphology and myxoid histology do not establish a metabolic dependency. A mechanistically resolved redox effect could change the choice of cystine, lipid-peroxidation and rescue experiments rather than repeat kinase screens.
prior_art_gate: Reuse NCC/USZ complete published screens and model authentication plus R1/R2/R3/R7 gates; assess primary EMC ferroptosis/oxidative nutrient/lipid literature and broader studies containing EMC. Historical disputed model pharmacology cannot ground EMC biology.
population: Every identifiable relevant public authentic EMC model/tissue/donor condition and adverse measurement, including broader sarcoma studies; generic identities remain unresolved.
comparators: Dose/time/assay matched non-EMC mesenchymal and nonmalignant controls where supplied; separate inhibitor response from mechanism-specific ferrostatin/liproxstatin/iron chelator or genetic rescue. Do not pool unknown donor overlaps or technical replicates.
strongest_alternative: Apparent sensitivity is broad cytotoxicity or culture/cell-density/media dependence, source misidentification, or a generic sarcoma effect; transcript abundance alone cannot resolve it.
defeat: No authenticated relevant perturbation/measurement, absent matched useful comparison or rescue, unfavorable controls, previously published answer without a new informative addition, or unresolved suitable public observations prevents advancing a claim. Do not turn this invented speculation failing into a negative paper.
selection: Mechanism chosen prospectively from question and potential usefulness; no expression result or drug hit was used to select it. Any later exploratory signal requires dated amendment and complete validation rather than relabelling this plan.
escalation: Notify integrating lead before any larger dataset stage; accessible relevant sources remain pending, not excluded for size.
stopping_rule: Within pilot scout primary evidence, reuse source gates, evaluate all eligible identified conditions at supplied resolution, then choose worthwhile claim, one bounded decisive follow-up or shelve. No manuscript before useful contribution.
